title: Mahābhārata, Sanskrit text with M. N. Dutt's English translation
description: Two columns. A set of one or more Sanskrit verses is followed by one English paragraph translating the whole set. A set can run across a column or page break. Speaker lines, such as संजय उवाच and Sanjaya said, are printed with the verses and with the translation.

group.description: A set of verses with the translation of the set, and any speaker lines printed with them.

speaker.description: A speaker line: centered Sanskrit, such as संजय उवाच, or bold English, such as Sanjaya said.

verse_set.description: One or more consecutive verses translated together.

verse.description: One Sanskrit verse, usually two lines, with its number, such as ॥२५॥.

translation.description: The English translation of a verse set, one paragraph.

running_header.description: The running title, such as DRONA PARVA or MAHĀBHĀRATA.

conventions: Transcribe Devanagari and English as printed, in Unicode NFC, with the printed digits and dandas.
